6 Minute English

Intermediate level

If you’ve got 6 minutes to learn English, listen to 6 Minute English! Improve your listening skills with extracts from BBC radio programmes on many different subjects. We help you to understand, and we also teach you key vocabulary.

If you want something easier, try Real Easy English to hear real conversations in easy English to help you improve your spoken English.
